summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $17.8B SPX premium and a low 0.42 P/C ratio. Significant directional conviction is visible in the massive accumulation of SPX 7000C and 8000C strikes expiring in 2031, with single-day buys exceeding $5B. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-10-16) and 8000C (exp 2031-12-19) positions, totaling billions in continuous accumulation over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in semiconductor names like MU, NVDA, and AMD, which are showing aggressive call-side dominance and low P/C ratios (0.41, 0.60, and 0.30 respectively).
